statements.proposition: This change makes service loading accept a path to a .py file directly, without breaking previously supported identifier forms.
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: Settled by reading the diff and the base source, not by running tests (sandboxed environment build was denied by the permission system). Feature part: at base, normalize_identifier raised ValueError('found a path but not a bento') for an existing .py file; at head a new elif returns (path.stem, working_dir or path.parent). Compat part: the new branch sits after all existing branches (bento.yaml, build files, dir with service.py is checked after it only for non-.py-file paths), so previously accepted inputs reach the same branches as before. Only other behaviour change is the wording of the multiple-services ImportServiceError message, which a caller matching the old text could notice; treated as not breaking.
evidence: gh api pulls/5230/files: modified src/_bentoml_impl/loader.py (+10 -1), added tests/unit/test_loader.py (+53)
Base loader.py (bf56762) normalize_identifier: existing path that is not bento.yaml/build file/dir with service.py falls to raise ValueError
Head patch adds `elif path.is_file() and path.suffix == '.py': return path.stem, working_dir or path.parent` before the service.py-directory branch
New tests cover .py file identifier, service.py directory backward compatibility, and multiple-services error message; not executed by me
